subject: An issued warning puts {{reportTarget}} on the desk

locus.descriptor: the secure briefing room where the issued report is on the desk

opening.text: The Secretary of State has a channel to {{reportTarget}} open tonight. The issued finding says: {{reportFinding}}
The source is {{reportSource}}. Confidence is {{reportConfidence}}, and the recorded gaps are {{reportGaps}}. I can task another collection effort; I cannot promise its answer in time.
A private warning reaches their government now. Recalling the ambassador would make the protest unmistakable and leave us with less room to test their answer.

replies.text: Task intelligence analysts to seek another assessment of the reported move before an overt response.

commitment.remembered: The President tasked another collection effort against the report target before deciding on an overt response.

rejoinder.text: The tasking goes out tonight. The report on the desk remains the only answer we have while another source is sought.

collection.question: What independent reporting bears on the reported foreign move?

replies.text: Deliver a private diplomatic warning to {{reportTarget}} about the reported move.

rejoinder.text: The Secretary of State can carry the warning privately. Their answer may come back faster than another assessment, but it will be shaped by knowing we asked.

replies.text: Recall the ambassador from {{reportTarget}} over the reported move, despite the loss of trust.

context.standing: An issued intelligence report has reached the President through the regular secure briefing. It records a finding about {{reportTarget}}, with its source and uncertainty attached.
context.precedent: A private warning can make another government pause without making the underlying intelligence public. It can also tell that government what this administration has noticed.

pressures.want: The Secretary of State wants a private warning while a diplomatic channel can still carry it.
The intelligence community wants the source and the report gaps weighed before an overt claim is made.

context.inaction: A warning left unanswered may become harder to use; no new collection is ordered by silence.
context.unknown: The issued report cannot establish whether the reported conduct will become a government decision.
